verdict.rationale: Teller documents API endpoints that an agent could call for live balances, transactions with pagination, identity and payments, all authenticated with Teller-issued mTLS client certificates. Link sessions run through the client-side Teller Connect widget rather than an agent-callable API, and webhooks are configured in the Dashboard. Probes found no llms.txt, docs.md or OpenAPI spec, and nothing mentions an MCP surface. Missing for 10: MCP server or agent-oriented surface, an API for creating link sessions, documented connection/enrollment management endpoints, granular scoped credentials for agents, a machine-readable API spec.
